The '''Pelgrin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Pelgrin sector/Legends|Pelgrin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Pelgrin]].
